source: verified poe.ninja rendered snapshot + exact current PoB allocation

critModel.payloadCdbStatus: unavailable on poe.ninja; using the common 191% carrier CDB as a labelled calculator proxy
critModel.method: Average shared crit multiplier inferred from Frost Darts 46% at 13% base and Entangle/Orb of Storms 35% at 10% base after dividing out Pinpoint Critical's 60% more Critical Hit Chance.

aggregateEffectMatchesStatus: Aggregate rendered effects are informational only and do not establish allocation. Exact current PoB node IDs are authoritative.
knownNodesStatus: Named passive allocations verified from the current poe.ninja Path of Building node IDs against GGG's official passive-tree export. Invocated Efficiency and Controlling Magic are not allocated.

gear.note: The rendered poe.ninja page exposes the base jewel and rune socket types, but not trustworthy names/modifier text for the equipped weapon, armour, rings, amulet or belt. No Mana, crit, CDB, CDR or recovery gear modifiers are guessed.

calculatorDefaults.carrierHitsStatus: manual preserved estimate; poe.ninja does not expose eligible Mana Flare trigger events per second
calculatorDefaults.otherRecoveryStatus: manual; 9% Mana recoup is conditional and is not auto-counted
calculatorDefaults.manaLeechStatus: manual; no qualifying attack-based Mana leech source verified
calculatorDefaults.archmageStatus: not exposed on the current poe.ninja character page; disabled by default rather than guessed
